headline: Bring new guests to your counter.
subheadline: goZaika helps curious diners discover a limited, chef-curated BAM Bag, reserve it, and pick it up directly from your restaurant.

pillars.title: Be discovered
pillars.body: Introduce your kitchen to diners looking for something worth showing up for.

pillars.title: Create a counter moment
pillars.body: Pickup brings the guest into your restaurant - with no delivery handoff.

pillars.title: Stay in control
pillars.body: You set the quantity, pickup window, and required food disclosures.

steps.title: Publish
steps.body: Create a limited BAM Bag release with timing and disclosures.

steps.title: Reserve
steps.body: A diner discovers and reserves the pickup in goZaika.

steps.title: Pick up
steps.body: Your team verifies the handoff at the counter.

controls: Your restaurant name and story stay visible.
You choose when and how many BAM Bags to release.
Dietary and allergen information is declared before purchase.
You can pause releases when operations require it.
isNot: A promise about specific bag contents
A replacement for your restaurant brand
readiness: A named owner for releases and handoffs
commercialNote: Commercial terms are discussed during partner qualification.
